native_rules: Win data is updated before action pushes: goal21 with finalBoard=false, Reactivation.UpdateProgressAfterWin, Session.Win and LevelManager.LevelEnd. Required native owner failures retain preceding side effects.

StartWinFlow invokes the bonus token owner only for bonus sessions, calls King.BeHappy only when the first speed-up read is false, re-reads speed-up after LevelEnd, and starts the audio coroutine only when that second read is true.
The queue pushes interrupt-type2 ShowWinLogo, RemainingMoves and ShowLevelWin in that order. Current action completion, including synchronous completion/reentrant queue advance, owns progression.

Main FlowExecuter restores type identity replacement, first auto-equivalent removal, duplicate running rejection, SupportsMultiple/SupportsOneExceptRunning, front priority, deferred auto actions, pause/resume, next-on-push enable counts, nested next mode and native Clear retention semantics. GetType is only compared; no reflected member invocation or string identity is used.

Logo action disables UI touch, yields the native0.1second wait, instantiates/shows the logo dialog, yields0.2seconds, plays the logo and enables UI touch. Both waits are serialized light settings; the native float bytes are at ELF0x3fb253c and0x3fb2548.
Remaining action queries the actual manager. If moves should be sent it shows its dialog; otherwise it resets top sorting, completes remaining moves immediately and completes its action.

Result action resets top sorting, reads the current session and branches on LeagueIndex>0. League bundle injection follows native hard/extreme availability and index modulo10 equals2/5/9, otherwise downloaded league bundle handling; normal sessions instantiate the default dialog.

LevelEnd returns for admin sessions, dispatches useless-move increment only when no useful move was made, dispatches download/tutorial reset/multiplier only for state3, then analytics and UserManager.LevelEnd in order. The UserManager.LevelEnd body is still an explicit owner dependency.

The real logo mesh reaches its configured3second close in the formal-scene fixture. That explicit UiDialog-owner boundary completes the logo action; the actual remaining manager closes its explicit dialog owner, which advances to the actual normal-result action and a recorded fixture dialog owner. No final-result UI or account persistence is fabricated.
